At Source Credit, we have our plans to serve you better right at the center of all we do, and our service offerings. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Executive Assistant to the MD

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full time

Job Description


	Ensure efficient scheduling of meetings, appointments, and events for the MD, minimizing conflicts and optimizing their time.

	Continuously improve the efficiency of administrative processes, streamlining tasks to save time and resources.
	Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including staff, clients, and partners.
	Responsible for the general administration of the Executive offices and other designated spaces as executive areas
	Oversee other support staff and services that support the executive office
	Attend to and prepare reports assigned by the Managing Director.
	Perform other tasks as may be assigned by the Managing Director.


Requirements


	Candidate should possess relevant formal education
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in similar roles
	Candidate must be vast with Microsoft office tools, note taking, report preparation and presentation
	Experience with work tools like Microsoft Teams, or others is important
	Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills is required
	Candidate must possess the ability to work independently and part of a team, should be a self-starter
	Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Executive Assistant to the MD Job at Source Microfinance Bank




        
    

        
        Source Microfinance Bank is a digital bank with a focus on how to serve you better always! At Source Credit, we have our plans to serve you better right at the center of all we do, and our service offerings. We also ensure we give the best customer service experience that is tailored just for you. Source Microfinance Bank is poised to change the face of banking in Nigeria. We are reinventing banking to empower a generation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Executive Assistant to the MD

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Ensure efficient scheduling of meetings, appointments, and events for the MD, minimizing conflicts and optimizing their time.
	Monitor and prioritize emails, ensuring that important messages are addressed promptly, and unnecessary emails are filtered or delegated.
	Support the MD in various projects by coordinating activities, gathering data, and helping with project management tasks.
	Continuously improve the efficiency of administrative processes, streamlining tasks to save time and resources.
	Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including staff, clients, and partners.
	Responsible for the general administration of the Executive offices and other designated spaces as executive areas
	Oversee other support staff and services that support the executive office
	Attend to and prepare reports assigned by the Managing Director.
	Perform other tasks as may be assigned by the Managing Director.


Requirements


	Candidate should possess relevant formal education
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in similar roles
	Candidate must be vast with Microsoft office tools, note taking, report preparation and presentation
	Experience with work tools like Microsoft Teams, or others is important
	Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills is required
	Candidate must possess the ability to work independently and part of a team, should be a self-starter
	Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Visa Officer Job at Aspom Travel Agency




        
    

        
        Aspom Travel Agency was founded on the 2nd of February, 2012 and has remained at the top of its game providing visa assistants, hotels, holiday packages, tours and flight deals to her clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Visa Officer
Job Location: Agungi, Lekki - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Advise clients on visa requirements, application procedures, documentation, fees, and processing timelines.
	Assess client documents to ensure they meet the requirements of the relevant embassy, consulate, or visa application centre.
	Prepare, review, and organize visa application documents before submission.
	Complete and submit visa application forms accurately.
	Schedule visa appointments, biometrics, interviews, and other required processes.
	Monitor visa applications and provide clients with timely updates on their application status.
	Liaise with embassies, consulates, visa centres, and relevant authorities when necessary.
	Identify missing, inconsistent, or inaccurate information and guide clients on necessary corrections.
	Maintain proper records of client applications, documents, payments, and application outcomes.
	Keep up to date with changes in visa policies, requirements, fees, and application procedures.
	Ensure client information and documents are handled confidentially.
	Follow up on pending applications and communicate delays or additional requirements to clients.
	Assist clients with visa-related enquiries and provide professional customer service.
	Maintain accurate reports of submitted, approved, refused, and pending applications.
	Work closely with the Ticketing and Holiday teams to ensure visa and travel arrangements are properly coordinated.
	Perform other visa-related duties assigned by the supervisor or management.


Requirements


	B.Sc., HND, or OND in Travel & Tourism, International Relations, Business Administration, or a related field with 1 – 3 years of visa processing or travel agency experience is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of visa application procedures and documentation requirements.
	Strong research and attention-to-detail skills.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Good computer and internet skills.
	Strong organizational and record-keeping abilities.
	Ability to handle confidential client information professionally.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet application deadlines.
	Professional, patient, proactive, and customer-focused attitude.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.
